declarations.explanation: The image provides the toolchain the development guide's Setup and validation section names: Node.js 24 from a Debian base, pnpm 11 (which switches to the exact packageManager version, pnpm@11.28.8) and public Repository Standards CLI 10.0.0 for source validation. TypeScript 7, oxlint 1 and Prettier 3 are pinned development dependencies the run installs with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, so the image leaves them to the worktree. It installs with RUN from package sources only, adds no user, agent tooling, ENTRYPOINT or CMD, and keeps the pnpm store outside the checkout.

Reconciliation: the one open ready-for-human issue, #559, was accepted on 2026-10-21, before #603 narrowed the label. It is agent work that edits .github/workflows/ci.yml, so under the installed State labels rule it would now carry ready-for-agent, its model label (it already has model:claude-opus-5-5) and factory:skip, as #603's Migration describes for existing agent-work issues. This adoption's pull request finishes it, so it is not relabelled. #603 itself relabelled no existing issue. The factory:skip label does not exist yet; under the rules whoever first applies it creates it.
